summary: Keep WheeLog public facility evidence bounded and allowlisted, with exact aggregate report states, separate source/retrieval clocks and an explicit two-observation local shortlist. MCP context must describe the actual command mirror surface and CLI bounds.
reason: The anonymous source envelope also includes contributor information and personal narratives; a reprint must rediscover its read-only request contract and strip those fields before cache or output. Search filters, aggregate reports and straight-line distance must never become guarantees of accessibility, individual report dates or a traversable route.
validated_outcome: Parser/transport/store/CLI regression tests and live search, compare, save, audit, distance, change and removal checks preserve unknowns, inapplicable questions and zero-count updates. Default --agent preserves exact question/count/requirement evidence, recheck reasons, distances and change values across collections.
